title: AI Grades My Speaking Tests, but Can't Find My Passport
titleZh: AI帮我批口语，却找不到护照
description: Steven describes using local transcription and AI to turn students' midterm group discussions into detailed feedback sheets, explains how the grades are weighted and why the tick marks didn't match the scores, and previews tomorrow's chunk-bank and 4-3-2 fluency activities. He also talks about an almost-forgotten TOEFL webinar, a tax-app mess caused by a lost passport, HSK flashcards that put him to sleep, and wanting to switch gyms.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content overview

sentences.zh: 今天的节目里，史蒂文讲了自己怎样花了差不多一整天，用AI把学生的口语转写稿和录音变成反馈表，结果比他预想的专业得多。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about how he spent almost a whole day using AI to turn students' speaking transcripts and recordings into feedback sheets, and the result was much more professional than he expected.

sentences.zh: 他还说明了期中成绩的占比，解释了为什么“等级分”和“打钩”有时对不上，并预告了明天的流利度练习。
sentences.en: He also explained how much the midterm grade is weighted, why the "level scores" and the "checkmarks" sometimes don't match, and previewed tomorrow's fluency practice.

sentences.zh: 接着聊到：差点忘掉的托福网络研讨会、因护照丢失而用不了的个税App、总让他昏昏欲睡的HSK6单词卡，还有想换健身房的念头。
sentences.en: Then he talks about a TOEFL webinar he almost forgot, an income tax app he can't use because he lost his passport, the HSK 6 flashcards that always make him sleepy, and his thoughts about switching gyms.

sentences.zh: 给老师用的AI（与隐私）
sentences.en: AI for Teachers (and Privacy)

sentences.zh: 史蒂文从去年起就觉得，大学应该为老师购买AI订阅。
sentences.en: Since last year, Steven has felt that universities should buy AI subscriptions for teachers.

sentences.zh: AI如今是基本的办公工具，就像电子表格。
sentences.en: AI is now a basic office tool, just like spreadsheets.

sentences.zh: 这样还有利于保护隐私：数据可以留在校内系统里，学生的错误也能用来改进下一轮课程。
sentences.en: This also helps protect privacy: the data can stay in the school's own systems, and students' mistakes can be used to improve the next round of the course.

sentences.zh: 他处理隐私的办法是：
sentences.en: His way of dealing with privacy is:

sentences.zh: 用本地转写。
sentences.en: Use local transcription.

sentences.zh: Whisper模型免费，可以在设备上运行。
sentences.en: The Whisper model is free and can run on your device.

sentences.zh: 学生在开头45秒做自我介绍，他就能分清谁是谁的声音。
sentences.en: Students introduce themselves in the first 45 seconds, so he can tell whose voice is whose.

sentences.zh: 删掉姓名，把文字稿交给AI，问它哪些是好的小组讨论。
sentences.en: He deletes the names, gives the transcript to the AI, and asks it which ones were good group discussions.

sentences.zh: 这一套今天花了他三四个小时。
sentences.en: Today this whole process took him three or four hours.

sentences.zh: 转写稿练习与期中成绩占比
sentences.en: Transcript practice and the weighting of midterm grades

sentences.zh: 周二和周三，各小组一起研读自己讨论的文字稿和录音。
sentences.en: On Tuesday and Wednesday, each group studied the transcripts and recordings of their own discussions together.

sentences.zh: 问身边的同学一句“你这里说的是什么？”，比在微信上发消息强多了。
sentences.en: Asking the classmate next to you, "What are you saying here?" is much better than sending a message on WeChat.

sentences.zh: 物联网班（两个女生、约14个男生）则更讲“效率”：一个人做前半部分，其余的人各做后半部分的一小块。
sentences.en: The IoT class (two girls and about 14 boys) was more about "efficiency": one person did the first half, and everyone else each did a small piece of the second half.

sentences.zh: 学生们一直追问分数。
sentences.en: The students kept asking about their scores.

sentences.zh: 其实期中只算一项课堂参与分，期末才更重要。
sentences.en: Actually, the midterm only counts as a single class participation score; the final is what matters more.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文负责的那一半成绩是：
sentences.en: The half of the grade that Steven is responsible for is:

sentences.zh: 期末考试 20%
sentences.en: Final exam 20%

sentences.zh: 口语 20%
sentences.en: Speaking 20%

sentences.zh: 写作 20%
sentences.en: Writing 20%

sentences.zh: 平时成绩 10%
sentences.en: Regular coursework 10%

sentences.zh: 另外50%由阅读和听力老师负责。
sentences.en: The other 50% is handled by the reading and listening teachers.

sentences.zh: 这些学生高考大多考了609到615分左右，这样的分数，请个好家教可是能赚“一大笔钱”的。
sentences.en: Most of these students scored around 609 to 615 on the gaokao, and with scores like that, a good private tutor can really earn "a big chunk of money."

sentences.zh: 等级分与打钩的矛盾
sentences.en: The conflict between letter grades and checkmarks

sentences.zh: 他按五项标准各打五分，再用一张换算表转成字母等级和百分制分数。
sentences.en: He gave up to five points for each of five criteria, then used a conversion table to turn the scores into letter grades and percentages.

sentences.zh: 真正的麻烦出在AI做的评分表上：它把标准简化得太过头，只要提到一个词就能打一个钩。
sentences.en: The real trouble was the rubric the AI made: it oversimplified the criteria so much that just mentioning a single word earned a checkmark.

sentences.zh: 结果学生满栏都是钩，却只拿了2.5或3分。
sentences.en: As a result, students had checkmarks in every column but only got a 2.5 or a 3.

sentences.zh: “那我为什么没拿5分？”
sentences.en: "Then why didn't I get a 5?"

sentences.zh: 问得好！
sentences.en: Good question!

sentences.zh: 开会时有人告诉他，像3.6、3.75这样的小数分也可以。
sentences.en: In a meeting, someone told him that decimal scores like 3.6 or 3.75 were fine too.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说，这是“人性化统计”。
sentences.en: In his words, this is "humane statistics."

sentences.zh: AI还发现，有几张表他只加了五项标准里的四项。
sentences.en: The AI also found that on a few sheets he had only added up four of the five criteria.

sentences.zh: 最妙的是，他让AI为每个学生截取一段说得好的音频和一段说得不好的。
sentences.en: The best part was that he had the AI clip one well-spoken audio segment and one poorly spoken one for each student.

sentences.zh: 他逐一核对了声音，全都准确。
sentences.en: He checked the audio one by one, and it was all accurate.

sentences.zh: 最后，他得到了50张整整齐齐的表。
sentences.en: In the end, he got 50 neat, tidy sheets.

sentences.zh: 想对分数提出异议的，欢迎来答疑时间找他。
sentences.en: Anyone who wants to dispute their grade is welcome to come find him during office hours.

sentences.zh: 语块库与4-3-2练习
sentences.en: Chunk Bank and the 4-3-2 Exercise

sentences.zh: 明天的课从“语块库”开始。
sentences.en: Tomorrow's class starts with the "chunk bank."

sentences.zh: 学生从文章里挑出有用的短语，译成中文，再按作者或话题分类。
sentences.en: Students pick out useful phrases from the articles, translate them into Chinese, and then sort them by author or topic.

sentences.zh: 这能培养认知流利度，专治那句经典的“我知道要说什么，就是不知道怎么说”。
sentences.en: This builds cognitive fluency and is a direct cure for that classic line: "I know what I want to say, I just don't know how to say it."

sentences.zh: 快问快答：一人读中文，另一人说英文。
sentences.en: Rapid-fire Q&A: one person reads the Chinese, the other says it in English.

sentences.zh: 接话搭档：练习“你的意思是……”
sentences.en: Conversation partners: practice phrases like "What you mean is..."

sentences.zh: 这类句式，期中考试里他只听到了非常初级的说法。
sentences.en: For sentence patterns like this, he only heard very basic expressions in the midterm exam.

sentences.zh: 4-3-2：同一个话题先讲四分钟，再讲三分钟，最后两分钟。
sentences.en: 4-3-2: speak on the same topic first for four minutes, then for three, and finally for two.

sentences.zh: 这样能砍掉学术圈出了名的“啰嗦废话”。
sentences.en: This cuts out the "long-winded filler" academia is notorious for.

sentences.zh: AI期中分析页面
sentences.en: AI midterm analysis page

sentences.zh: 稍后他会给学生看一个名为《期中小组讨论：你们表现如何》的网页，涵盖三个班，学生用A、B、C、D标记。
sentences.en: Later he'll show the students a web page called "Midterm Group Discussions: How Did You Do?", which covers three classes, with students labeled A, B, C and D.

sentences.zh: 点一下某个学生，就会跳出他那部分的文字稿。
sentences.en: Click on a student, and their part of the transcript pops up.

sentences.zh: “这简直就是AI本该替你们做的事。”
sentences.en: "This is exactly what AI is supposed to do for you."

sentences.zh: 平均分是25分里的16分，约等于雅思5分。
sentences.en: The average score was 16 out of 25, roughly equivalent to IELTS 5.

sentences.zh: 需要改进的六点是：
sentences.en: The six points to improve are:

sentences.zh: 多用文章里的内容
sentences.en: Use more content from the article

sentences.zh: 接着别人的话往下说
sentences.en: Build on what others say

sentences.zh: 直接称呼对方
sentences.en: Address each other directly

sentences.zh: 五项工具标准都要用，别只盯着成本
sentences.en: Use all five tool criteria; don't focus only on cost

sentences.zh: 观点要有依据
sentences.en: Back up your points

sentences.zh: 声音要更大、更稳
sentences.en: Speak louder and more steadily

sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，打分的是他本人，不是AI。
sentences.en: To be clear, he did the grading himself, not the AI.

sentences.zh: 没有AI的话，这四个小时会“枯燥得让人发疯”。
sentences.en: Without AI, those four hours would be "maddeningly boring."

sentences.zh: 写作考试与托福研讨会
sentences.en: The Writing Exam and the TOEFL Webinar

sentences.zh: 写作考试他还一份没碰，希望下周五左右发还。
sentences.en: He hasn't touched a single writing exam yet, and hopes to hand them back around next Friday.

sentences.zh: 一位前同事问他今晚要不要参加ETS.org的托福认证网络研讨会，他居然忘得一干二净！
sentences.en: A former colleague asked him whether he was joining ETS.org's TOEFL certification webinar tonight, and he had completely forgotten about it!

sentences.zh: 不管考什么，他都希望由人来打分，由机器来找证据，而不是一句“感觉不太对”。
sentences.en: Whatever the test, he wants a person to do the grading and a machine to find the evidence, not just a vague "it doesn't feel quite right."

sentences.zh: 丢失的护照与个税App
sentences.en: The Lost Passport and the Individual Income Tax App

sentences.zh: 给外国人的忠告：别弄丢护照，尤其是里面夹着工作签证的那本。
sentences.en: A word of advice for foreigners: don't lose your passport, especially the one with your work visa in it.

sentences.zh: 按时申报个税可以扣除住房等项目，他大约能退回7,000元。
sentences.en: If you file your income tax on time, you can deduct things like housing, and he could get back about 7,000 yuan.

sentences.zh: 他自嘲这只是“象征性的一点心意”。
sentences.en: He jokes that it's just "a token gesture."

sentences.zh: 他的纳税记录登在一个护照号下，个税App却登在另一个号下。
sentences.en: His tax records are registered under one passport number, but the tax app is registered under another.

sentences.zh: 要合并，就得用旧护照，可它不是在北京，就是在加拿大。
sentences.en: To merge them, he'd have to use the old passport, but it's either in Beijing or in Canada.

sentences.zh: 他可不愿花1,300元专门跑一趟去找。
sentences.en: He really doesn't want to spend 1,300 yuan making a special trip to go find it.

sentences.zh: 汉语单词卡、早睡与换健身房
sentences.en: Chinese flashcards, going to bed early, and switching gyms

sentences.zh: 他在AnkiDroid上每天复习约100张HSK5的卡片。
sentences.en: Every day he reviews about 100 HSK 5 flashcards on AnkiDroid.

sentences.zh: HSK从六级改成九级后，HSK5算中等水平。
sentences.en: Since HSK changed from six levels to nine, HSK 5 counts as intermediate.

sentences.zh: HSK6的词再加100个，他就被“放倒”了。
sentences.en: If he adds another 100 HSK 6 words, they "knock him flat."

sentences.zh: 昨晚他九点就睡着了，凌晨一点醒来，灯还全亮着。
sentences.en: Last night he fell asleep at nine, woke up at 1 a.m., and the lights were all still on.

sentences.zh: 他想在小区对面的健身房开始新一轮训练周期。
sentences.en: He wants to start a new training cycle at the gym across from his apartment complex.

sentences.zh: 红灯、警察检查，再加上冬天的严寒，去现在这家健身房一个来回，几乎要花一个小时。
sentences.en: With red lights, police checks, and the bitter winter cold, a round trip to his current gym takes almost an hour.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 用得好，AI不会取代老师。
sentences.en: Used well, AI won't replace teachers.

sentences.zh: 它只是替人干掉繁琐的活儿，让学生得到更好的反馈。
sentences.en: It just takes the tedious work off people's hands, so students get better feedback.

sentences.zh: 现在，他只盼着AI能帮他找到护照。
sentences.en: Right now, he's just hoping AI can help him find his passport.
